basecamp_empty_text: Publish your first mod or build and this is where you will follow its downloads, reviews and field reports.
basecamp_attention_empty_text: No broken reports, unanswered questions or missing pieces right now.
basecamp_attention_broken: {name}: {count, plural, one {# report says it is broken} other {# reports say it is broken}} on the current game build
basecamp_attention_questions: {name}: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} without an answer
basecamp_attention_gallery: {name}: the gallery has {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}, aim for 3 or more
basecamp_attention_source: {name}: no link to the source code
basecamp_attention_reviews: {name}: {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} without a reply
basecamp_attention_rejected: {name} was not approved: see the reason and resubmit
basecamp_live_empty_text: Downloads, reviews, comments and field reports on your mods show up here as they happen.
basecamp_live_signals_failed: Recent activity could not be loaded.
basecamp_mods_intro: Everything you published, in any status. Edit a listing, release a version or check why something needs attention.
basecamp_mods_reports_open: {count, plural, one {# broken report} other {# broken reports}}
basecamp_mods_results: {count, plural, =0 {No mods match} one {# mod shown} other {# mods shown}}
basecamp_milestone_none: Every milestone within reach is already yours.
basecamp_milestone_to_go: {count, plural, one {{display} download to go} other {{display} downloads to go}}
basecamp_milestone_mod_label: Progress of {name} to its next milestone
basecamp_panel_error_text: The rest of the page works. Try again in a moment.
basecamp_conflict_detail: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page has the latest version now: check it and try again.
basecamp_save_invalid: Fix the marked fields to save.
basecamp_unsaved_text: Your changes to this mod have not been saved and will be lost.
basecamp_editor_quality_ok: Nothing missing: a gallery, a full description, the source, platform, tags and licence.
basecamp_editor_pending_title: In review at the Ranger Station
basecamp_editor_pending_text: Rangers usually decide within 72 hours. You can keep improving the listing meanwhile.
basecamp_editor_rejected_text: The rangers asked for changes. Fix the listing and resubmit it from the Status tab.
basecamp_editor_removed_text: This mod is no longer public and cannot be edited.
basecamp_listing_description_hint: Markdown. What it does, how to use it, known issues. 300 characters or more help players decide.
basecamp_listing_source_hint: GitHub or any public repository. Players trust mods with open source more.
basecamp_listing_video_hint: A link to a video on YouTube, shown after the gallery.
basecamp_listing_language_hint: The language you wrote the description in.
basecamp_listing_original_author_hint: For ports and continuations: who made the original.
basecamp_listing_nsfw_hint: Hidden from players who did not opt in.
basecamp_listing_error_name: The name needs between 2 and 80 characters.
basecamp_listing_error_url: Enter a full address that starts with https://
basecamp_listing_error_youtube: Enter the link of a YouTube video.
basecamp_listing_error_links: One of the support links is not a valid address.
basecamp_listing_save_failed: The listing could not be saved
basecamp_media_cover_hint: 16:9, shown on cards and at the top of the page. A new cover is cropped here before it uploads.
basecamp_media_cover_current: Current cover. Choose a new image below to replace it.
basecamp_media_cover_removed: The cover will be removed when you save.
basecamp_media_cover_legacy: This cover is still being moved to the new image storage; it can be replaced but not removed yet.
basecamp_media_gallery_hint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrows. Describe each image for players who cannot see it.
basecamp_media_gallery_empty: No images yet. Listings with 3 or more images get more downloads.
basecamp_media_locked: Being moved to the new storage: it keeps its place for now
basecamp_media_add_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF up to 10 MB. {left} left.
basecamp_media_full: The gallery holds {max} images at most.
basecamp_media_wrong_type: That file is not a supported image.
basecamp_media_too_large: That image is larger than 10 MB.
basecamp_media_upload_failed: The image could not be uploaded.
basecamp_media_failed_hint: Remove the images that failed or choose them again.
basecamp_media_save_failed: The media could not be saved
basecamp_versions_intro: Every version you released, including those in review. Yank a version to warn players away from it: its link keeps working with a warning.
basecamp_versions_yank_text: Players see a warning on this version and the latest good one is offered instead. You can undo it later.
basecamp_versions_yank_failed: The version could not be yanked
basecamp_versions_unyank_failed: The yank could not be undone
basecamp_compat_safe_remove: Can it be removed without breaking the save?
basecamp_compat_tested_hint: The builds you tested each version on. Players see them next to the field reports.
basecamp_compat_no_versions: There is no available version to mark.
basecamp_compat_tested_failed: The tested builds could not be saved
basecamp_compat_field_hint: What players report for each version and game build.
basecamp_compat_no_current: No reports on the current game build yet.
basecamp_compat_outdated: Possibly outdated: the game changed since the last version.
basecamp_compat_table: Field reports by version and game build
basecamp_compat_to_inbox: Answer field reports in the inbox
basecamp_settings_no_actions: There is nothing to change in this status.
basecamp_settings_published: Public and listed in Explore and search.
basecamp_settings_pending: Waiting for the rangers. Only you can see it.
basecamp_settings_unlisted: Reachable by its link, hidden from lists and search.
basecamp_settings_rejected: The rangers asked for changes before publishing it.
basecamp_settings_archived: Kept for reference: marked as archived and hidden from lists.
basecamp_settings_removed: Removed by the rangers. Contact them if you think it is a mistake.
basecamp_settings_unlist_hint: Hide it from lists and search. Anyone with the link can still download it.
basecamp_settings_publish_hint: Show it in lists and search again.
basecamp_settings_archive_hint: Mark it as no longer maintained, optionally pointing players to its successor.
basecamp_settings_resubmit_hint: Send it back to the Ranger Station once you made the requested changes.
basecamp_settings_removal_hint: Ask the rangers to take it down. The request is reviewed like a report.
basecamp_settings_archive_text: It stays reachable with an «archived» notice. Pick a successor to send players to your new mod.
basecamp_settings_removal_text: Tell the rangers why. They answer through Signals.
basecamp_settings_removal_sent: Removal requested: the rangers will review it
basecamp_settings_failed: The status could not be changed
basecamp_settings_drafts: Unfinished uploads and versions are kept as drafts until you resume or delete them.
basecamp_analytics_intro: Downloads, views, sources and ratings of your mods, including the history since 2023.
basecamp_analytics_empty_text: Publish a mod and its numbers show up here.
basecamp_analytics_compat_pick: Choose a mod to see its field reports by game build.
basecamp_inbox_intro: Comments, bug reports, reviews and field reports on your mods. Answer from here.
basecamp_inbox_review_reply_label: Your public reply to this review
basecamp_inbox_reply_failed: The reply could not be posted
basecamp_inbox_acknowledged: Report acknowledged: the reporter was told
basecamp_inbox_fixed: Marked as fixed: the reporters were told
basecamp_inbox_no_versions: This mod has no available version to pick.
basecamp_inbox_empty_open_text: Nothing is waiting for an answer. New comments and reports on your mods land here.
basecamp_inbox_empty_text: Comments, bug reports, reviews and field reports on your mods will show up here.
basecamp_badges_intro: Your Creator tier, the next milestones and the badges you are closest to.
basecamp_badges_tier_none: {downloads} lifetime downloads: the first tier starts at 1,000.
basecamp_badges_all_earned: You earned every badge there is to see.
basecamp_badges_none_text: Publishing, answering players and keeping mods working on new patches all earn badges.
basecamp_versions_changelog_text: Markdown works. Players see it on the mod page and in the update signal.
basecamp_listing_legacy_title: This description keeps its old layout
basecamp_listing_legacy_body: It was written on the old site, so its HTML still renders as formatting. Convert it to Markdown to edit it like any new description.
basecamp_listing_convert_save_first: Save or discard your changes first.
basecamp_listing_convert_body: Raw HTML will show as plain text from now on. There is no way back.
